note: Local fixtures for anyone running ALIGN Pay without ALIGN. They mirror the four rules the fictional owner of Kettle & Kesar recorded in ALIGN. The receipts here are local fixtures, not ALIGN receipts.

decisions.statement: The support agent may refund up to $50 per order on its own. Any refund above $50 needs my approval first.
decisions.why: Small refunds should be instant for customers; bigger ones need a person to look at them.

receipts.quote: The support agent may refund up to $50 per order on its own. Any refund above $50 needs my approval first.

decisions.statement: A customer gets at most one refund in any 30 days. The agent must refuse a second refund within 30 days; the customer can email me instead.
decisions.why: Repeat refunds are where abuse happens; a person should talk to the customer.

receipts.quote: A customer gets at most one refund in any 30 days. The agent must refuse a second refund within 30 days; the customer can email me instead.

decisions.statement: Never refund an order that has an open PayPal dispute. Answer the dispute instead.
decisions.why: Refunding during a dispute can pay the customer twice.

receipts.quote: Never refund an order that has an open PayPal dispute. Answer the dispute instead.

decisions.statement: Wholesale invoices use net 15 terms with at most a 10% discount, and any invoice over $2,000 needs my approval before it is sent.
decisions.why: Cash flow: long terms and deep discounts on big orders need a person's call.

receipts.quote: Wholesale invoices use net 15 terms with at most a 10% discount, and any invoice over $2,000 needs my approval before it is sent.
